analysis:
Integration of 18 units: changelog fragments, docs (build.md, test.md, attestation.md, cli-reference.md, provider-authorization.md), and Swift diagnostics. No serving, crypto or wire code changes in the supplied evidence.

Production change: status (StatusCommand.swift 148-153), DoctorRunner.swift (37-39, 78-79) and DoctorCommand.swift (358-363, 414-415) now derive a displayed authorization (displayedProviderAuthorization, which keeps an unexpired App Attest lease visible even when the last renewal is older than snapshotMaxAge) and a strict removalAuthorization (currentProviderAuthorization). Both go to ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.summary(_, removalAuthorization:, now:). Per the head-side docs (provider-authorization.md 92-106) and test descriptions, positive MDM removal advice needs the matching fresh decision plus mdm_removal_ready. Otherwise the summary says to keep profiles. The unenroll keep-serving path (UnenrollCommand+KeepServing.swift 21-27) still gates on removalReady(strict currentProviderAuthorization) and passes removalAuthorization: authorization. Its removal gate is unchanged and not weakened.

Threat mapping: the changes align with TB-011, T-053 (stale authorization), T-057 (premature MDM removal, which stays gated on fresh readiness), T-052 and T-058. The display change is local, read-only and operator-facing. The coordinator remains the serving authority (final-writer and handoff checks). The tests described in unit 17 assert strict expiresAt > now, NaN/inf rejection, matching process identity and coordinator, online status, protocol 1, and writtenAt freshness.

Residual questions: the implementations of displayedProviderAuthorization/displayedStatus, liveDecision and summary are visible only through other passes' replay (about 63 units omitted from replay) and docs. Unit 14's replay indicates the bounds are enforced: the lease must be unexpired, and process, coordinator and writtenAt checks are retained. A final reviewer with the full ProviderCore source should confirm that an expired or revoked lease is never displayed as current, and that no serving or removal decision consumes the displayed variant. Other summary() callers outside the supplied files were not seen. The state file is same-UID editable, but it is already informational and the removal path rechecks readiness. No security regression identified.
